summary: Crexendo, Inc. filed an 8-K to report entry into a credit agreement with Wells Fargo Bank for a $5M revolving line of credit and a $5M term loan to finance the recent acquisition of Estech Systems, LLC. The loans bear interest at SOFR plus 2.25%-2.75%, mature May 2029, and are secured by substantially all assets. The filing is a routine debt financing agreement, not a special-situation event itself.
